title: pilosella caespitosa var. floribunda
intro: Pilosella caespitosa var. floribunda, commonly known as Alpine Mouse-Ear or Alpine Daisy, is a flowering plant belonging to the dandelion family (Asteraceae). It is used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, helping to reduce pain and inflammation, and its antimicrobial action, which can help combat infections. The therapeutic actions of Pilosella caespitosa var. floribunda include its ability to modulate the immune system, reduce fever, and alleviate gastrointestinal issues. The plant's bioactive constituents include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
